No. The evidence maps about **81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2021**, or **2.23%** of the 3,643.5-hectare property—not the whole property. Another 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and was not counted as an event.

Most of the mapped event area was classified as planted forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish clearing or a change in land use; it could include plantation harvesting or other causes.
